question: Who invented HTML in 1990?
solution:
The correct answer is **Tim Berners-Lee**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Tim Berners-Lee** invented HTML in 1990.
 
• HTML stands for **HyperText Markup Language**.
 
• It is the standard markup language for creating web pages.
 
• Tim Berners-Lee also developed the first web browser and web server.
